ai_review.summary: Clear recording of an uneven show with a problematic Terrapin Station, yet it still delivers some decent moments.
ai_review.review: The download offers surprisingly clear audio that makes the performance worthwhile despite its unevenness. The concert suffers from a mid‑set shutdown on “Terrapin Station,” but there are enough good spots to keep it from being a total waste.
